title: Stall-Day Credit Schedule — Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
**Schedule.** When Bridgewell replaces an item on a Homeowner Service Contract after a stalled repair, a stall credit is added to the stalled-repair replacement cost as a flat dollar amount, never compounded, before that cost is compared with the remaining item and aggregate benefits. The stall credit is 5.00 for each stall day, rounded to the cent.

**Counting stall days.** The stall days are counted by the kind of request:

| Stalled request | Stall days |
|---|---|
| emergency request | the calendar days after the request date up to and including the reversal date |
| routine request on a tier whose routine contact window is 24 hours or fewer | the calendar days after the repair authorization date up to and including the reversal date |
| any other routine request | no stall days are counted |

The routine contact window is the hours within which the assigned contractor must contact the customer on a routine request. By tier:

| Tier | Routine contact window | 24 hours or fewer? |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell ApplianceCare | 48 | no |
| Bridgewell SystemsCare | 48 | no |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Bronze | 48 | no |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Silver | 48 | no |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Gold | 24 | yes |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum | 24 | yes |

**Worked credits (hypothetical dates).**
1. Emergency request placed May 1; repair authorization reversed June 10. Stall days run from May 2 through June 10: 30 days in May and 10 in June, 40 in all. Credit: 40 times 5.00, that is 200.00.
2. Routine request on Bridgewell HomeCare Gold; repair authorized May 5; reversed June 10. Stall days run from May 6 through June 10: 26 and 10, 36 in all. Credit 180.00.
3. Routine request on Bridgewell HomeCare Silver: no stall days are counted, so no stall credit.

The reversal date counts as a stall day; the request date (emergency) or the repair authorization date (routine) does not.
